name: Coconut jaggery ladoo (vegan)
steps: Dry-roast 1 cup (80 g) desiccated coconut on low heat for 3 minutes until just fragrant.
Melt 60 g grated jaggery with 3 tbsp water and 1 tsp coconut oil for 3 minutes to a sticky syrup.
Stir in the coconut and 1/4 tsp cardamom powder; cook 2 minutes until it holds together.
Cool 5 minutes, then shape into 6 small balls with oiled palms.
Store airtight up to 4 days.

name: Date and oat energy balls
steps: Soak 8 pitted dates (100 g) in warm water for 10 minutes, drain.
Blitz dates with 1/2 cup (45 g) rolled oats, 1 tbsp cocoa and 1 tbsp chia seeds into a sticky crumb.
Add 1 tsp coconut oil and pulse once.
Roll into 8 balls; chill 15 minutes before eating.
Oats may carry gluten; use certified oats if coeliac.

name: Vegan coconut milk rice kheer
steps: Wash 1/4 cup (50 g) rice and simmer in 1 cup water for 15 minutes until very soft.
Add 1 cup (240 ml) coconut milk and cook on low for 10 minutes, stirring.
Turn off heat; stir in 40 g jaggery and 1/4 tsp cardamom so the milk does not split.
Rest 5 minutes; serve warm or chilled.

name: Ragi banana halwa (vegan)
steps: Roast 1/2 cup (60 g) ragi flour in 2 tbsp coconut oil for 4 minutes on low.
Mash 1 ripe banana with 40 g jaggery and 1 cup (240 ml) hot water; pour in while whisking.
Cook 6 to 8 minutes, stirring, until thick and glossy.
Add 1/4 tsp cardamom, set in a plate, cut into squares.

name: Tofu bhurji with toast
steps: Crumble 200 g firm tofu with your hands.
Heat 1 tbsp oil; crackle 1/2 tsp cumin, then fry 1 chopped onion, 1 tsp each minced garlic and ginger and 1 green chilli for 4 minutes.
Add 1 chopped tomato, 1/4 tsp turmeric, 1/2 tsp salt; cook 3 minutes.
Add tofu, toss 4 minutes, finish with coriander.
Serve with 2 toasted slices bread.

name: Soya chunk curry with roti
steps: Soak 50 g soya chunks in hot water 10 minutes; squeeze dry.
Fry 1 sliced onion, 1 tsp garlic and 1 tsp ginger in 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes.
Add 2 chopped tomatoes, 1 tsp coriander powder, 1/2 tsp turmeric, 1/2 tsp garam masala; cook 6 minutes.
Add chunks and 3/4 cup water; simmer 8 minutes.
Serve with 2 rotis (60 g wheat flour).

name: Chana masala quinoa bowl
steps: Rinse 1/2 cup (90 g) quinoa; simmer in 1 cup water 12 minutes, rest 5.
Fry 1 chopped onion with 1 tsp garlic-ginger in 1 tbsp oil 5 minutes.
Add 1 tomato, 1 tsp chana masala, 3/4 cup (130 g) boiled chickpeas and 1/4 cup water; cook 8 minutes.
Bowl the quinoa, top with chana, chopped cucumber and lemon.

name: Bajra moong khichdi
steps: Soak 1/2 cup (90 g) cracked bajra and 1/4 cup (50 g) moong dal 30 minutes.
Heat 1 tbsp ghee, crackle 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp grated ginger, 1/4 tsp turmeric.
Add drained grains and 3 cups water; pressure cook 4 whistles.
Mash lightly, salt, serve with 1/2 cup curd. Naturally gluten-free.

name: Jowar roti with baingan bharta
steps: Roast 1 large brinjal (300 g) over flame 10 minutes until collapsed; peel and mash.
Fry 1 chopped onion and 1 tsp garlic in 1 tbsp oil 4 minutes; add 1 tomato and chilli, cook 4 minutes.
Fold in brinjal and 1/2 tsp salt; cook 5 minutes.
Knead 1 cup (120 g) jowar flour with hot water to a soft dough; pat 2 rotis on a damp cloth and cook on tawa 2 minutes per side.

name: Akki roti with coconut chutney
steps: Mix 1 cup (130 g) rice flour, 1/4 cup grated carrot, 2 tbsp chopped onion, coriander, 1 green chilli, 1/2 tsp cumin, salt and about 1/3 cup warm water.
Pat dough into 2 thin discs on oiled tawa with wet fingers.
Cook with 1 tsp oil per side, 3 minutes each, until golden.
Blend 1/4 cup coconut, 1 chilli, salt for chutney.

name: Quinoa vegetable pulao
steps: Rinse 1/2 cup quinoa (90 g).
Heat 1 tbsp oil, add 1/2 tsp cumin, 1 chopped onion, 1 tsp garlic-ginger; fry 4 minutes.
Add 1/2 cup chopped carrot, beans and peas; stir 2 minutes.
Add quinoa, 1 cup water, salt; cover and cook 12 minutes. Rest 5 minutes and fluff.

name: Soft moong khichdi for toddlers
steps: Wash 1/4 cup rice and 1/4 cup yellow moong dal together.
Pressure cook with 1 small grated carrot, a pinch of turmeric, no salt and 2 cups water for 4 whistles.
Mash well to a porridge texture; add 1 tsp ghee and 1/4 tsp cumin powder.
Cool before serving; add a tiny pinch of salt only for children over 1 year.

name: Banana ragi pancakes (soft, nut-free)
steps: Mash 1 ripe banana smooth.
Mix with 1/4 cup (30 g) ragi flour, 2 tbsp wheat flour and 1/3 cup water to a pourable batter.
Cook small 7 cm pancakes on a lightly oiled pan 2 minutes per side.
Cut into strips; supervise eating. No nuts, no honey.

name: Soft mini veg uttapam (lunchbox)
steps: Use 1 cup (200 ml) ready idli batter.
Fold in 2 tbsp each grated carrot, finely chopped tomato and onion.
Spoon 6 small 6 cm uttapams on an oiled tawa; cover and cook 3 minutes per side until soft.
Cool and pack; no chutney needed. Nut-free.

name: Mild curd rice lunchbox
steps: Mash 1 cup (160 g) warm cooked rice with 1 tbsp milk.
Stir in 3/4 cup curd and 1/4 tsp salt once rice is cool.
Temper 1/2 tsp mustard seeds, 4 curry leaves and a few ginger shreds in 1 tsp oil for 30 seconds; pour over.
Pack with an ice pack; eat within 4 hours.

name: Soft paneer pea roti roll
steps: Make 2 soft rotis from 60 g wheat flour; brush with 1 tsp ghee.
Mash 80 g paneer with 1/2 cup boiled, mashed peas, a pinch of turmeric and cumin and 1/4 tsp salt.
Warm filling 2 minutes in a pan.
Spread on rotis, roll tight, slice into rounds.

name: Soft low-salt dal rice
steps: Cook 1/3 cup rice and 1/3 cup toor dal in 3 cups water with turmeric until very soft, 4 whistles.
Mash to a loose texture.
Season with 1/4 tsp salt only; temper 1 tsp ghee with 1/2 tsp cumin.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon for flavour in place of salt.

name: Lauki moong dal soup
steps: Cook 1/4 cup moong dal with 1 cup chopped lauki, 1/2 tsp ginger and a pinch turmeric in 2.5 cups water for 3 whistles.
Blend roughly.
Temper 1/2 tsp cumin in 1 tsp oil; add.
Salt lightly (1/4 tsp) and serve warm.

name: Gond laddoo (postpartum tradition)
steps: Fry 2 tbsp (20 g) gond in 1 tbsp ghee in small batches until it puffs; crush.
Roast 1/2 cup (60 g) wheat flour in 3 tbsp ghee 8 minutes until golden.
Mix in crushed gond, 2 tbsp chopped almonds, 2 tbsp dry coconut, 1/4 tsp cardamom; cool slightly.
Stir in 60 g powdered jaggery; shape 6 laddoos.
Traditionally eaten after childbirth; evidence for milk supply is limited. High in calories and sugar.

name: Panjiri (postpartum tradition)
steps: Roast 1/2 cup (60 g) wheat flour in 3 tbsp ghee 8 minutes.
Separately roast 1/2 cup makhana and 2 tbsp chopped almonds; crush coarsely.
Fry 1 tbsp gond in ghee until puffed; crush.
Mix all with 2 tbsp powdered sugar and 1/2 tsp dry ginger. Eat 2 tbsp per serving.
Traditional postnatal food; not proven to raise milk supply.

name: Methi laddoo (lactation tradition)
steps: Soak 1 tbsp fenugreek seeds 6 hours, drain and grind coarse.
Roast 1/2 cup (60 g) wheat flour in 3 tbsp ghee 8 minutes; add methi paste, cook 4 minutes.
Add 2 tbsp chopped almonds and 1/2 tsp dry ginger.
Mix in 60 g jaggery powder, shape 6 laddoos.
Used traditionally for lactation; fenugreek can lower blood sugar and upset digestion, so check with a doctor.

name: Jeera ajwain saunf water
steps: Boil 2 cups (400 ml) water with 1/2 tsp cumin, 1/4 tsp ajwain and 1/2 tsp fennel for 5 minutes.
Simmer 3 more minutes, strain.
Sip warm in two portions.
Traditional digestive drink for new mothers; a comfort, not a milk booster.

name: Dalia milk porridge (new mother)
steps: Roast 1/2 cup (80 g) dalia in 1 tsp ghee 3 minutes.
Add 1 cup water; cook covered 10 minutes.
Add 1 cup (240 ml) milk, cook 5 minutes until creamy.
Sweeten with 1 tbsp jaggery and cardamom. A classic postnatal food.

name: Ajwain garlic dal soup (postnatal)
steps: Cook 1/3 cup moong dal and 1/4 cup rice with turmeric in 2.5 cups water, 3 whistles.
Fry 4 crushed garlic cloves and 1/2 tsp ajwain in 1 tsp ghee 1 minute.
Pour over dal, add salt.
Garlic is a traditional postnatal food; some babies fuss after garlic-heavy maternal meals.

name: Banana peanut butter toast (pre-run)
steps: Toast 2 slices bread 2 minutes.
Spread 1 tbsp peanut butter thinly on each.
Top with 1 sliced banana and a pinch of salt.
Eat 60 to 90 minutes before running.

name: Sweet banana jaggery poha (pre-run)
steps: Rinse 1 cup (60 g) thick poha, drain 2 minutes.
Mix with 1 sliced banana, 1 tbsp grated jaggery, 2 tbsp coconut.
Add 1/4 tsp cardamom and a pinch of salt.
Eat 60 to 90 minutes before a run.

name: White rice with moong dal and ghee (pre-run)
steps: Cook 3/4 cup (150 g) rice.
Pressure cook 1/3 cup moong dal with turmeric and 2 cups water, 3 whistles.
Mash dal, temper with 1 tsp ghee, salt.
Eat 2.5 to 3 hours before a long run; low fibre keeps the gut settled.

name: Cauliflower sabzi with roti (low potassium)
steps: Cut 200 g cauliflower into florets; boil in plenty of water 3 minutes and drain (leaches some potassium).
Fry 1/2 onion, 1 tsp garlic and ginger in 1 tbsp oil for 4 minutes.
Add cauliflower, turmeric, coriander powder and 1/8 tsp salt; cook 6 minutes.
Serve with 2 rotis. Dietitian-guided; not a medical plan.

name: Egg white bhurji with rice (low sodium)
steps: Cook 3/4 cup rice.
Fry 1/4 cup chopped onion, 1 tsp garlic and 1/4 cup shredded cabbage in 1 tsp oil for 3 minutes.
Pour in whites of 4 eggs; scramble 3 minutes with pepper and no added salt.
Serve over rice. Check protein and phosphorus limits with your renal dietitian.

name: Cabbage capsicum poha (low potassium)
steps: Rinse 1 cup poha (60 g) and drain.
Heat 2 tsp oil, pop 1/2 tsp mustard seeds and 6 curry leaves.
Cook 1/4 cup each onion, cabbage and capsicum 4 minutes.
Fold in poha and a pinch of salt; steam 2 minutes, add lemon.

name: Lauki dal with phulka (GERD-gentle)
steps: Cook 1/3 cup moong dal with 1 cup lauki cubes and turmeric in 2.5 cups water, 3 whistles.
Temper 1 tsp ghee with 1/2 tsp cumin and 1/2 tsp ginger.
Salt lightly.
Serve with 2 phulkas (60 g flour). No onion, garlic, tomato or chilli, which often trigger reflux.

name: Oat and banana porridge (GERD-gentle)
steps: Simmer 1/2 cup (45 g) oats in 1/2 cup water and 1/2 cup (120 ml) milk 5 minutes.
Stir in 1 sliced banana; cook 2 minutes.
Dust cardamom and serve warm.
Eat at least 2 to 3 hours before lying down.

name: Idli with mild coconut chutney (GERD-gentle)
steps: Steam 4 idlis (200 ml batter) 10 minutes.
Grind 1/4 cup coconut, 1 tbsp roasted chana dal, small piece ginger, salt with water.
Skip green chilli and tamarind to keep it mild.
Serve idlis warm with chutney.

name: 15-minute one-pot masoor dal
steps: Rinse 3/4 cup (150 g) masoor.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pot; fry 1/2 tsp cumin, 1 chopped onion and 2 garlic cloves for 3 minutes.
Add 1 tomato, 1/2 tsp turmeric, 1/2 tsp chilli powder, lentils and 2.5 cups water.
Simmer 10 minutes until soft; salt and serve.

name: One-pot masala pasta
steps: In one pan heat 1 tbsp oil; fry 1 onion, 3 garlic cloves, 1/2 capsicum 2 minutes.
Add 2 chopped tomatoes, 1/2 tsp chilli flakes, salt; mash 2 minutes.
Add 100 g penne and 1.5 cups water; cover and boil 9 minutes, stirring.
Finish with 2 tbsp grated cheese.

name: 15-minute one-pot lemon pea pulao
steps: Rinse 3/4 cup (150 g) basmati.
Heat 1 tbsp oil; fry 1/2 tsp cumin, 1 sliced onion, 1 chilli and 1 tsp ginger 2 minutes.
Add 1/2 cup frozen peas, rice and 1.5 cups water; cover.
Cook 10 minutes, rest 2, squeeze in lemon.

name: Curd poha (no-cook)
steps: Rinse 1 cup (60 g) poha and drain.
Mix with 3/4 cup curd and 1/4 cup water.
Fold in 1/4 cup each grated cucumber, carrot, coriander and 1/4 tsp salt.
Rest 5 minutes and eat.

name: Peanut butter banana wrap (no-cook)
steps: Spread 2 tbsp peanut butter on 1 wheat tortilla.
Place 1 banana at the edge.
Sprinkle 1 tsp mixed seeds (pumpkin or sunflower).
Roll tight and slice.

name: Roasted chana cucumber chaat
steps: Mix 1/2 cup roasted chana with 1 chopped cucumber, 1/4 cup onion, 1 tomato.
Add 1 tsp chaat masala and the juice of half a lemon.
Add 2 tbsp chopped coriander.
Toss and eat right away so the chana stays crisp.
Pack chana separately if carrying it, adding the veg just before eating.

name: Veg manchurian dry
steps: Squeeze moisture from 1 cup grated cabbage and 1/2 cup carrot; mix with 3 tbsp maida, 2 tbsp cornflour, salt, shape 12 balls.
Shallow fry balls in 1/3 cup oil at medium heat 6 minutes until golden; drain.
Stir-fry 1 tbsp each minced garlic, ginger, 1/4 cup onion and 1 chilli on high heat 1 minute.
Add 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp chilli sauce, 1 tsp vinegar, 2 tbsp water; toss in balls and spring onion 1 minute.

name: Veg hakka noodles
steps: Boil 120 g noodles 4 minutes, drain, toss with 1 tsp oil.
Heat 1 tbsp oil on high; stir-fry 1 tsp garlic, 1/2 onion 30 seconds.
Add 1 cup shredded cabbage, carrot and capsicum; toss 2 minutes.
Add noodles, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp vinegar, pepper; toss 1 minute and garnish spring onion.

name: Veg egg fried rice
steps: Use 1.5 cups (250 g) cold cooked rice.
Scramble 2 eggs in 1 tsp oil; set aside.
Heat 1 tbsp oil high; fry 1 tsp garlic, 1/2 cup mixed carrot, beans, cabbage 2 minutes.
Add rice, 1 tbsp soy sauce, pepper; toss 3 minutes; stir in egg and spring onion.

name: Penne arrabbiata
steps: Boil 120 g penne in salted water 9 minutes; reserve 1/4 cup water.
Warm 2 tbsp olive oil with 4 sliced garlic cloves and 1 tsp chilli flakes 1 minute.
Add 3 chopped ripe tomatoes (300 g); simmer 10 minutes.
Toss in pasta and splash of pasta water; finish with basil. Contains gluten, no dairy.

name: Home margherita pizza (tawa/oven)
steps: Knead 150 g maida, 1/2 tsp yeast, 1/2 tsp salt, 90 ml water and 1 tsp oil; prove 1 hour.
Simmer 2 chopped tomatoes with 1 minced garlic clove and salt 8 minutes for sauce.
Roll to 22 cm; spread sauce and top with 80 g mozzarella.
Bake 230 C 10 minutes (or covered tawa 8 minutes); add basil.

name: Vegan kimchi fried rice with egg
steps: Chop 1/2 cup vegan kimchi (no fish sauce).
Heat 1 tbsp oil; fry 1/4 onion, 1 tsp garlic and kimchi 3 minutes.
Add 1.5 cups cold rice, 1 tsp soy sauce; stir-fry 3 minutes.
Fry 2 eggs sunny side up; top with sesame oil, seeds and spring onion.

name: Rajma burrito bowl
steps: Cook 3/4 cup rice with lime and salt.
Fry 1/2 onion, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp paprika 3 minutes; add 3/4 cup boiled rajma and 1/4 cup water, mash lightly 6 minutes.
Mix salsa: 1 tomato, 1 tbsp onion, lime.
Bowl rice, rajma, corn, lettuce, salsa.

name: Hummus platter with veg and pita
steps: Blend 1 cup boiled chickpeas, 2 tbsp tahini, juice of 1 lemon, 1 garlic clove, 2 tbsp olive oil, 3 tbsp cold water until smooth.
Plate in a bowl and drizzle olive oil.
Cut 1 cucumber and 1 carrot into sticks.
Serve with 2 warm pita; contains sesame and gluten.

name: Avocado toast
steps: Toast 2 slices sourdough.
Mash 1 ripe avocado with lemon and salt.
Spread on toast; drizzle 1 tsp olive oil.
Finish with chilli flakes.

name: Grilled cheese veg sandwich
steps: Slice 1 onion, 1 tomato, 1/2 capsicum.
Spread green chutney on 4 slices; layer veg and 60 g grated cheese.
Butter outer sides (1 tbsp); grill 3 minutes per side until crisp.
Cut diagonally.

name: Baked falafel wrap
steps: Soak 3/4 cup dried chickpeas overnight; blend with 1/2 onion, 3 garlic cloves, coriander, 1 tsp cumin, salt coarsely.
Shape 8 patties, brush with oil, bake 200 C 25 minutes flipping once.
Mix 1 tbsp tahini, lemon and water for sauce.
Wrap 4 falafel in 2 tortillas with lettuce, cucumber and sauce.
